Hi Sophie —

Thanks — welcome aboard. I pushed this into our onboarding queue and attached a short vendor onboarding packet and a sample invoice CSV that maps our fields to a PO number. High level answers below, details in the packet: 

- Invoice mapping: include the Aurabiz PO number in the invoice header as PO_NUMBER (we also include a customer reference field customer_account_id: AUR-7782). If your system requires a UPN/URN please use our finance reference shown in the packet.
- Remit: we can provide bank account details for EFT (SEPA/IBAN) in the onboarding packet; wire and ACH options available depending on region.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days from invoice date (Net 30). We support consolidated monthly invoices (preferred for customers with recurring usage) or invoice-per-PO — specify preference in the vendor form.
- VAT: for EU customers we typically issue VAT invoices when applicable. If Aurabiz is registered for reverse-charge, we can accept reverse-charge invoices; we will need your VAT ID and a signed VAT self-certification form.

I've attached: redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf (includes remit formatting, required tax fields, sample invoice layout) and sample_invoice_fields.csv (headers you can feed to your AP ingestion).

Next steps: if you can return the completed vendor form plus your VAT ID and bank test details (for SEPA: test transaction reference) we’ll complete the registration. If you need us to sign a Master Purchase Agreement first, happy to route via DocuSign — see link in thread metadata.

CCing Laura (payments) and Karthik (legal/integration) for VAT and MPA exceptions.

Thanks,

Hi Sophie —

Quick VAT and invoice-format notes from payments: 

- EU VAT handling: if Aurabiz is VAT-registered and elects reverse-charge, please include a valid VAT ID on the vendor form and tick the reverse-charge box. We will record the VAT ID and print the reverse-charge statement on our invoices. If you require self-bill invoices (Aurabiz creates and sends the invoice on our behalf), we can support that but we need a signed self-bill agreement and the format specification (UBL/Peppol or PDF).
- Invoice fields: required fields for automatic AP ingestion: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), invoice_total_currency, invoice_total_amount, po_number, customer_account_id, remit_iban (for SEPA), remit_swift, tax_breakdown lines (tax_rate, tax_amount). Optional: cost_center and GL_code.
- PO matching: Our invoices include line-level PO references when requested. For your EDI team, we can emit a PO_REF column per line.
- Attachments: please attach a PDF copy of any signed MPA or procurement paperwork to the returned vendor form.

Attached: sample_invoice_fields.csv (same as Marcus’ but with example rows) and a short EU VAT checklist.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
